runAccounting.countingCaveat: The top-level evidence.writes array flattened cumulative page snapshots. Its 29 entries are not 29 distinct network requests; exact duplicate records reduce to 14 requests per successful run.

knownReplayPayload.cause: Normal product replay persistence triggered by PO-equivalent play, pause, refresh, exit and re-entry actions.

unknownPayloads.reason: The original observer retained only replay subobjects. For requests without a replay subobject it stored replay:null and discarded the full payload.
unknownPayloads.safeInference: They targeted the same session-state PATCH endpoint and were emitted during page initialization/refresh or replay actions, but their fields cannot be reconstructed.

stateComparison.retainedRuntimeEvidence: Replay checkpoint values and visible replay state only; not a complete server state snapshot.

scopeConclusion.reason: Only session 849 was addressed and ownership was validated, but retained evidence does not establish that session 849 is a designated disposable QA row.

rollback.blocker: No retained exact pre-run session-state snapshot or payload hashes exist. Current state was not fetched because the incident order forbids further authenticated writes and login itself uses POST. Any rollback value would be a guess.

futureCapturePolicy.default: Observe and hash attempted session-state payloads, then return a synthetic success without sending the PATCH.
futureCapturePolicy.writeEnabledMode: Requires B75_ALLOW_QA_CHECKPOINT_WRITES=true, exact matching B75_QA_SESSION_ID, owner validation and a positive hard B75_QA_CHECKPOINT_WRITE_CAP.
